statements.statement: The 2020 paper on wrist-sensor heart-rate accuracy in older adults has been retracted at the authors' request.
The reason is duplicate publication: the paper repeats the data and findings of the authors' 2019 paper.
The editors found no problem with the data, so the findings (within 4.8 bpm of ECG in 200 adults) likely still stand in the 2019 original.
The paper reported wrist sensors within 4.8 bpm of ECG in 200 adults aged 70 or over.
The draft should cite the 2019 paper instead of the 2020 paper.
The draft cites Nguyen and Cole (2020) once, in the Introduction, as one of three sources for wrist sensors being accurate to about 5 bpm in older adults.
The retraction covers the whole paper, so this citation is affected.
The retraction's reason is duplicate publication, and the editors found no problem with the data.
The same findings are in the authors' earlier 2019 paper.
Because it is a supporting use and severity is medium, the impact is low.
The citation can be replaced with the 2019 paper.
Keep the Introduction citation and cite the retraction notice with it.
Also cite the authors' earlier 2019 original after checking it gives the same finding.
